Crafted of the Finest Solid Brass Materials All mounting hardware included Available in a variety of lifetime designer finishes Products are provided with a limited lifetime warranty Assembled in the USA Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 3.9x1.6x3 Box dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 3x3x3 Shipping weight, lbs: 1 Installation Instruction Technical Specification A20-Installation.PDF A20-Specification.PDF
